thread:
sam: Noticing rack-21 has a rising number of kernel softirqs and GPU driver interrupts since 01:40 PST. Latency p95 on shared tenants up ~3x.

lucy: Any recent deploys cutoff? or model changes that might increase DMA/PCIe churn?

dave: stream-infer rolled a q8 quant change at 01:35 for their staging traffic, looks like their batch multiplier jumped too.

infra-bot: alert: interrupt-spike-detector fired on rack-21 at 01:47 PST, assigned to @sam.

sam: Correlating perf counters: PCIe write bandwidth spikes and NIC rx queue stalls. Also seeing KV cache thrash on sibling tenants.

frank: Short-term action: eBPF nic shaping to rate-limit tenant > 50MB/s for 30m? We have a small shim ready in /ops/snippets/ebpf-ratecap.

mia: That avoids costly carveouts but won't fix GPU memory pressure. If background DMA dominates, we should isolate noisy tenant to an ephemeral warm slice.

dave: Can we do this: 1) add eBPF cap on stream-infer (quick), 2) migrate a handful of latency-SLA tenants to reserved-warm pool in same AZ (avoids cross-AZ egress), 3) schedule model rollouts with batch-multiplier guardrail.

lucy: Cost note: reserving 4-GPU warm nodes in us-west adds ~ $2.6k/month. Migration automation will take ~2 engineer-days.

sam: I'll apply eBPF cap now. Command:
```
ssh ops@rack-21 && sudo ./apply_ebpf.sh --tenant stream-infer --limit 50MB
```

infra-bot: action: ebpf-ratecap applied to stream-infer at 01:59 PST.

frank: After cap, interrupts down ~30%, KV thrash down ~25%, p95 trending down but p99 still elevated for a few tenants.

mia: Next step: create ephemeral warm-slice (2 nodes, auto-evacuate) and tag routing with qos:lowlat for the moved tenants. We should enable preemptive drain policy so slice can be reclaimed under global shortage.

dave: Also add a rollout gate in CI to block batch-multiplier > 16 for APAC/US-west edges. Small patch in infra-templates: add validator in deploy pipeline.

lucy: Agree. For long-term: we need shard-aware KV eviction and per-tenant KV quotas to avoid whole-host fallout. Add to roadmap and prioritize after the upcoming capacity sprint.

sam: Summary: 1) applied eBPF cap (monitoring), 2) plan ephemeral warm-slice experiment (owner: mia), 3) rollout guardrail added to CI (owner: dave), 4) backlog item for KV shard quotas (owner: lucy).

infra-bot: monitor: re-eval in 6h and notify if p99 > 300ms for 5m.

mia: I'll spin up the experiment later today and report metrics (p50/p95/p99, KV eviction rate, delta cost) in #ops-results.

sam: Thanks everyone. Keep lightweight updates only; escalate if p99 regresses. :rocket:
